youtube.description:
Flat maps stretch everything near the poles. Watch each country slide to its real size 🌍 Did Greenland fool you again?
Comment your score out of 4 👇

Follow for a new quiz every day! 🧠

#map #geography #truesize #whichisbigger #quiz #shorts

Data: CIA World Factbook (United Kingdom 243,610 km²; Italy 301,340; Finland 338,455; Japan 377,915; Spain 505,370; Madagascar 587,041; Greenland 2,166,086; Algeria 2,381,740).
Outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). The shapes are moved on the globe and re-projected (Mercator) – no resizing by hand.
Music: original.

story.title: This Map Is Lying To You #2
story.hookLine: This map is still lying to you. Which is really bigger?
story.question: Which is really bigger?

lines.a: Italy! About a quarter bigger than the whole UK.
Japan! Finland only looks bigger because it sits so far north.
Madagascar! The island beats all of Spain.
Algeria! The biggest country in Africa. Think you got all four? Go again!
